== OPS.01 Reproducible image model deployment ==
Intent: Pinned upstream version, licenses, model weights and scalable inference fallback 
Test: Fresh install, no-cloud fallback and logs
 BOOK/LECTURE A05 ITK Software Guide | Volume 2 — Image reading/writing, filtering, registration, segmentation and analysis; find exact subchapter in chosen edition | https://itk.org/ITKSoftwareGuide/html/ | verified topical volume; exact chapter pending
 BOOK/LECTURE A14 TRIPOD-LLM | Model/data/evaluation reporting checklist; consult full checklist and elaboration | https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC12104976/ | verified publication
 PAPER P02 nnU-Net: self-configuring medical segmentation | https://www.nature.com/articles/s41592-020-01008-z
 REPOSITORY R02 nnU-Net v2 | https://github.com/MIC-DKFZ/nnUNet 
  Inspect: Read dataset format, nnUNetv2_predict workflow, inference pre/postprocessing and tests 
  Reuse: Adopt supported nnU-Net v2 inference API in isolated worker 
  Avoid: Do not copy training engine or mix incompatible checkpoints 
  Verify: Bad-channel, missing-weight, source-affine and prediction tests
 REPOSITORY R05 MONAI | https://github.com/Project-MONAI/MONAI 
  Inspect: Inspect transforms, MetaTensor/affine behavior, data readers, metrics and tutorials 
  Reuse: Adopt supported transformations and segmentation metrics 
  Avoid: Do not use unrelated organ models as breast segmentation 
  Verify: Image-mask transforms, invertibility, geometry unit tests
 REPOSITORY R01 MAMA-MIA | https://github.com/LidiaGarrucho/MAMA-MIA 
  Inspect: Read README, nnUNet subtree, download and checkpoint instructions; identify channels, transforms and mask meaning 
  Reuse: Use compatible vetted model inference or verified reference masks 
  Avoid: Do not assume checkpoint availability, licensing or external validity 
  Verify: Run one approved image, compare mask/physical measurements, record resource usage
